_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: The Lord has gone up, and we wait for the promise.
We gather in one place and pray.
With one accord the disciples kept to prayer.
We wait for the gift the Father gives.
Holy Father, keep them in your name, that they may be one.
Make us one as you are one.
Christ is risen!
Christ is risen, alleluia!

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Come up the stairs to the room where they waited, doors closed against the city, hearts turned toward a promise not yet kept.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
They were of one accord, the women and the eleven, holding to prayer in the long space between the going and the coming.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
And over them, even now, the Lord is praying: Holy Father, keep them, that they may be one as we are one.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
So we wait together, and we will not wait in vain.
Christ is risen, alleluia!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The Lord has ascended; in the upper room we wait.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
With one accord we hold to prayer.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
He prays for us: that we may be one.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
We wait for the promise. Come, let us worship.
Christ is risen, alleluia!
